description: This file defines the RestJsonSerializer class responsible for serializing requests for the REST-JSON protocol in the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the RestSerializer class and manages JSON formatting and request payload construction.

classes.name: RestJsonSerializer
classes.description: Serializes requests for the REST-JSON protocol, handling JSON payload creation and content type configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with the service API, endpoint, and optional JSON formatter, setting up content type and formatter instance.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Builds the request payload by serializing the structure shape to JSON and sets appropriate headers and body content.
